app.name: SpesaSmart NL
app.tagline: Every supermarket offer in one place.
app.description: Compare supermarket offers in the Netherlands and find the cheapest route for your shopping list.

more.title: More
more.installAndroid: Android: open the browser menu and choose 'Install app'.
more.installIos: iPhone or iPad: tap Share and choose 'Add to Home Screen'.
more.aboutBody: SpesaSmart NL is a personal project and is not affiliated with the supermarkets it names. Prices come from public offer pages and open data; every offer shows its source and when it was collected.
more.privacyBody: No account, no ads, no tracking. Your list belongs to this device: for that the app keeps a random number in a cookie, and a second cookie remembers your language. Nothing else is stored.
more.forgetBody: Removes all your lists from the server and this device's cookie. This cannot be undone.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Prices are not kept offline, so you never see an outdated price. Try again once you are back online.
